name: Jarl's Sentinel
theme: An oath-sworn Nordic sentinel entrusted with the Jarl's safety, using disciplined shield formations, decisive interception, and commanding battlefield presence to protect leaders, allies, and critical ground.
visualIdentity: Crimson and charcoal equipment accented by dark oak, polished steel, restrained gold, fur trim, a crested helm, a winged spear, and amber oathbound effects.
consistency: Use the same face, hairstyle, shield design, spear design, armor silhouette, helmet crest, fur placement, and crimson, charcoal, dark oak, steel, gold, and amber palette across all assets.

starterAbilities.name: Oathwall Guard
starterAbilities.description: Establish a disciplined defensive wall around allies.

starterAbilities.name: Royal Intercept
starterAbilities.description: Intercept attacks directed toward protected allies.

starterAbilities.name: Sentinels Command
starterAbilities.description: Issue commands that strengthen nearby defenders.
